preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit compiler-specific vulnerabilities

exploit_hint: The contract uses Solidity 0.6.12 which has known vulnerabilities. As owner, exploit compiler-specific issues like storage layout corruption, inheritance problems, or ABI encoding bugs. Use owner privileges to call functions like setTaxFeePercent, setLiquidityFeePercent, or setMaxTxPercent with malicious values that trigger unexpected behavior due to compiler bugs. Alternatively, use the lock/unlock functions to manipulate ownership state.
